outOfScope: Autonomous DOMAIN_ACTIVATION, event-driven wake-up and FE/BE parallel autonomy.
Global ProductStateProjection, product-completeness or closure semantics.
Global organization scheduler, role-stage workflow or next-domain dispatcher.
Generic graph database or generic semantic-equivalence engine.
constraints: Dependency edge is not work ordering.
Invalidation is not organization or workflow-stage reset.
Product semantic lineage and Blackboard work lifecycle are distinct state spaces.
Claim authority, execution policy and domain write authority do not imply one another.
Historical accepted claims and obligations remain reconstructable after becoming stale, revoked or superseded.
Container revision alone is not sufficient authority to invalidate unrelated semantic subjects.
Semantic equivalence guessed by an LLM cannot prune required invalidation in the first implementation slice.
invariants: Board dependency DAG != product semantic lineage
claim authority != execution policy != domain write authority
historical claim validity != currentness for new mutation
no LLM semantic guess may prune required invalidation in v1
architectureDecisions: CrossDomainObligation states WHAT another domain owes; it is never a dispatch command
source domain cannot choose target worker, strategy, runtime or priority
only accepted lineage from DomainPublicationReceipt enters product dependency truth
dependency invalidation follows exact semantic subjects and reverse transitive closure, not artifact containers/stages
semantic claim/obligation payloads are immutable; currentness lives in separate heads/transitions
precision comes from stable RequirementClaim/AcceptanceCriterion/etc subject keys and exact assertion refs
downstream publication uses pre/post input-currentness handshake so upstream invalidation cannot miss a racing new edge
historical claims remain reconstructable after becoming STALE/REVOKED/SUPERSEDED
implementationSlices: C1: DomainWriteAuthorityPolicy + trusted publisher + CAS DomainWriteAuthorityHead
C2: immutable SemanticClaim + SemanticClaimHead/currentness transitions and immutable CrossDomainObligation + ObligationHead
C4: authoritative ProductDerivationEdge persistence + deterministic DependencyImpactAnalysis + currentness transition/reconciliation
